title: Meta suicide alert routed to Uttar Pradesh Police brings officers to a 25-year-old in Meerut within eight minutes, and he is treated in hospital
summary: Meta's suicide alert about a 25-year-old man's Instagram video brought Meerut police to his home within eight minutes, and his condition improved after hospital treatment.
account: On 7 June 2026 a 25-year-old man from the Sardhana area of Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, posted an Instagram video. In it he appeared to drink a white liquid. Police said that Meta sent a suicide alert about the post to the Social Media Center at Uttar Pradesh Police headquarters at 6:53 pm. The center alerted Meerut Police, and a Sardhana team reached his home within eight minutes. They found him in a critical condition with a bottle of suspected liquid nearby and took him to hospital, where his condition improved after treatment. He told police that he was under stress following the end of a relationship. Police data cited by the Press Trust of India credit such alerts with 3,011 lives saved statewide from 1 January 2023 to 31 May 2026. On 6 January 2026 Decode reported its own interviews with Uttar Pradesh officers. They described rescues and a false alarm, and the outlet noted that Meta publishes no false-positive data for India. On 22 October 2026 the Times of India reported that police credit the alerts with more than 4,000 lives saved from 1 January 2023 to 10 October 2026.
purpose: Built to flag posts and live videos indicating suicide or self-harm risk for review and, in imminent cases, referral to emergency services. This benefit is that purpose.
system: Meta proactive self-harm detection on Instagram with alert routing to the Uttar Pradesh Police Social Media Center
deployer: Meta Platforms with the Uttar Pradesh Police Social Media Center (agreement signed March 2022)
taxonomy_note: A suicide intervention; Trustible's only health type is physical health.

ratings.reason: Police found him in a critical condition after apparent ingestion, and he was treated in hospital within minutes of the alert. Police describe the outcome as a life saved.

ai_role.statement: Police sources say Meta sent the alert after the post. They do not state whether Meta's classifier or a user report flagged it. Meta's documentation and NPR describe the process as machine-learning detection with human review before contacting authorities. The record relies on that description and should be read with that caveat.

echoes.setting: Dwarka, Delhi (reported 5 June 2021): Delhi Police CyPAD received a Facebook alert at about 12:50 am on a self-harm live video; the man was found with heavy blood loss, taken to hospital and AIIMS Trauma Center, condition stable (PTI/The Tribune)

Ambedkarnagar, Uttar Pradesh (late January 2023): Meta alert at 11:37 pm on a student's Instagram photos of pills; police arrived within 15 minutes and prevented the attempt (PTI/The Tribune, 5 February 2023)
Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh: Instagram live of a man preparing to hang himself; Inspector Anita Chauhan arrived within 13 minutes and prevented the attempt (PTI/The Tribune, 5 February 2023)
Upstate New York, from a Facebook promotional video described by NPR (17 November 2018): officers found a woman who had taken medication and got her to a local hospital
Firozabad, Uttar Pradesh: a 22-year-old posted a video of himself swallowing camphor tablets; police traced him within five minutes and he survived (Decode, 6 January 2026).
Unnao, Uttar Pradesh: a 19-year-old posted a video with a noose; an officer arrived within 16 minutes, found the noose tied and poison under his pillow, and intervened (Decode, 6 January 2026).

Kanpur Dehat, Uttar Pradesh: police traced a college student after an alert on an Instagram video with tablets; she denied any suicidal intent and said that she posted it for views, a false alarm (Decode, 6 January 2026).

brief: Police said that, at 6:53 pm on 7 June 2026, Meta sent a suicide alert about a 25-year-old Meerut man's Instagram video, and that a Sardhana police team reached him within eight minutes and took him to a hospital, where his condition improved.[1] The arrangement between Meta and Uttar Pradesh Police has run since an agreement signed in March 2022.[2] The police credit the alerts with 3,011 lives saved statewide from 1 January 2023 to 31 May 2026.[3] For the period to 10 October 2026 the figure is more than 4,000. Those counts come from the police, and no outside audit of them is known. Police sources do not say whether Meta's classifier flagged the post or a user reported it. Meta publishes no false-positive data for India, which leaves open how often an alert sends officers to someone who was never at risk.[4]

fields.summary: Meta's suicide alert about a 25-year-old man's Instagram video brought Meerut police to his home within eight minutes, and his condition improved after hospital treatment.
fields.account: On 7 June 2026 a 25-year-old man from the Sardhana area of Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, posted an Instagram video. In it he appeared to drink a white liquid. Police said that Meta sent a suicide alert about the post to the Social Media Center at Uttar Pradesh Police headquarters at 6:53 pm. The center alerted Meerut Police, and a Sardhana team reached his home within eight minutes. They found him in a critical condition with a bottle of suspected liquid nearby and took him to hospital, where his condition improved after treatment. He told police that he was under stress following the end of a relationship. Police data cited by the Press Trust of India credit such alerts with 3,011 lives saved statewide from 1 January 2023 to 31 May 2026. On 6 January 2026 Decode reported its own interviews with Uttar Pradesh officers. They described rescues and a false alarm, and the outlet noted that Meta publishes no false-positive data for India. On 22 October 2026 the Times of India reported that police credit the alerts with more than 4,000 lives saved from 1 January 2023 to 10 October 2026.

echoes.setting: Dwarka, Delhi (reported 5 June 2021): Delhi Police CyPAD received a Facebook alert at about 12:50 am on a self-harm live video; the man was found with heavy blood loss, taken to hospital and AIIMS Trauma Center, condition stable (PTI/The Tribune)

Ambedkarnagar, Uttar Pradesh (late January 2023): Meta alert at 11:37 pm on a student's Instagram photos of pills; police arrived within 15 minutes and prevented the attempt (PTI/The Tribune, 5 February 2023)
Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh: Instagram live of a man preparing to hang himself; Inspector Anita Chauhan arrived within 13 minutes and prevented the attempt (PTI/The Tribune, 5 February 2023)
Upstate New York, from a Facebook promotional video described by NPR (17 November 2018): officers found a woman who had taken medication and got her to a local hospital
Firozabad, Uttar Pradesh: a 22-year-old posted a video of himself swallowing camphor tablets; police traced him within five minutes and he survived (Decode, 6 January 2026).
Unnao, Uttar Pradesh: a 19-year-old posted a video with a noose; an officer arrived within 16 minutes, found the noose tied and poison under his pillow, and intervened (Decode, 6 January 2026).

Kanpur Dehat, Uttar Pradesh: police traced a college student after an alert on an Instagram video with tablets; she denied any suicidal intent and said that she posted it for views, a false alarm (Decode, 6 January 2026).
